Subject: POC kickoff — hybrid vs onsite logistics and sample prompts

Diego —

Thanks again for the demo today. Novus would like to lock in a hands-on kickoff so we can move into a two-week POC. A few asks up front so we can prepare on our side:

- Preferred date: we are aiming for the week of Nov 16 — Nov 20. Is there a recommended day for Redwood for a full-day working session?
- We expect ~12 engineers + 3 product owners. Curious about onsite visitor process (badging, NDA), and whether you recommend fully onsite or a hybrid setup with a few remote attendees.
- For the hands-on part we want a prompt review session, routing tests (multi-tenant routing scenarios), and a load ramp to ~150 concurrent sessions. Can you share an initial load test plan?
- Also need to confirm recording policy for demos / whether breakout sessions will be recorded.

We can provide a space at Novus HQ in downtown SF if an onsite is easiest. Let me know what works and what you need from us (attendee list, compliance docs, sample prompts).

Appreciate it —
Lara Chen

Hi Lara —

Thanks — great to hear Novus is ready to move. Quick answers and proposed plan:

- Dates: Our team has best availability Wed Nov 18 for a full-day working session (we can do Nov 17 or 19 as backups).
- Format: hybrid works well. For the hands-on throughput test we prefer at least the majority of attendees (8–10) onsite to ensure consistent network and AV; remote participants can join for framing and some breakout rooms.
- Visitor logistics: we require a list of attendees to pre-clear with security and a signed Redwood NDA addendum (I can send the template). For building access we will need names and IDs 48 hours before.
- Load test plan: propose a three-stage ramp (10 -> 50 -> 150 concurrent sessions over 30 minutes) with a warmup to populate KV cache. We’ll need a representative prompt set (~200 prompts) and expected tokens-per-response distribution.
- Recording: we typically record demos for internal review but will respect customer restrictions. If you prefer recording only for the main demo and not exec breakouts we can configure that.

Attaching a rough agenda/playbook and a first-pass load test checklist. Marissa — can you handle room booking and on-site AV? Aditya — will you own the load test and prompt ingestion on your end?

Thanks,

--
Diego Fernandez
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
